text:
Marta: Heads-up — reconciliation flagged a weird case for BlueFjord (acct BF-204). Two invoices got issued for the Feb billing window. One has the expected line items, the other is missing the "network egress" line and is ~USD 1,240 short. Saw this while reconciling net usage.
Leo: Can you paste the invoice IDs and amounts? I can check the job logs quickly.
Marta: Invoice IDs: INV-2024-02-9931 (full, $12,340.00) and INV-2024-02-9931-RETRY (partial, $11,100.00). The retry one lacks network_egress. Customer only paid the full invoice.
Sophia: Ugh. We usually dedupe by invoice hash. If the retry process dropped a line before hashing, it could have created a second invoice instead of updating. Raj any charge impact? Did the payment gateway record two charges?
Raj: Payment gateway shows one successful charge for INV-2024-02-9931, nothing for the retry. No double-charge thankfully.
BillingBot: [alert] invoice-generator: retry-run created invoice INV-2024-02-9931-RETRY (status: draft) — reason: "lineitem mismatch after transform" — job-id: bg-job-7721
Leo: Quick look at the generator logs — I see a retry path that runs transform_pipeline v2, and a downstream step bail_on_missing returned false. Snippet:
```
2024-02-28T03:12:09Z INFO transform_pipeline v2 start job bg-job-7721
2024-02-28T03:12:10Z WARN missing_lineitems: customer BF-204 network_egress not found in usage cache
2024-02-28T03:12:11Z INFO downstream: create_invoice draft INV-2024-02-9931-RETRY
```
Leo: Looks like the retry flow doesn't rehydrate the cached network_egress record before hashing. I can open a small fix to include the full usage set before dedupe.
Sophia: For now finance needs to mark INV-2024-02-9931-RETRY as void/draft and attach a note for the customer if we send outgoing PDFs. Marta can you put a hold on sending any invoices to BF-204 until we confirm?
Marta: Hold placed. Also creating accounting ticket now — will request a credit memo if the retry hit collections later. Ticket: ACCT-5428.
Raj: Thx. If the retry is draft and not paid, we just need to prevent sending and reconcile the missing line on the canonical invoice. Do we know why network_egress was missing from the usage cache?
Leo: My hypothesis: a race between ingestion (s3->usage-cache job) and the invoice-generator retry. If ingestion is slightly delayed and retry fires, the transform pipeline gets partial usage. Fix options: 1) make retry wait for a successful cache refresh for that account window, 2) make dedupe/hash use source of truth (raw usage) rather than cache. I'll prototype 1) first.
Sophia: For audit trail can we attach the generator logs and the two invoice PDFs to ACCT-5428? Also add a note "do not send".
Marta: Attached logs and PDFs to the ticket. Adding explicit "do not send" label.
BillingBot: [info] ACCT-5428 created by Marta assigned to Sophia. SLA: 3 business days.
Raj: Customer communication — we should preemptively message BF support to say we found a duplicate draft invoice and will not charge twice. Marta, can you draft a short note? Keep it minimal.
Marta: Drafted message and sending to support queue for review. Message: "We identified a duplicate draft invoice for your account due to an internal retry. Only INV-2024-02-9931 was charged. We will void the duplicate draft and you will not be billed again. Apologies for the noise. — Finance"
Leo: I'll open PR with the wait-for-cache step and link it here: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/invoice-generator/pulls/1823
Sophia: :eyes: will review after unit tests. If safe, let's ship quick patch to staging and run a replay of the affected job bg-job-7721 on staging.
Marta: Thanks all — keeping the thread updated. I'll close ACCT-5428 once the duplicate is voided and staging replay looks good.
Leo: Quick follow-up: can we run a scan to find other accounts with a draft invoice suffix "-RETRY" created between 2024-02-25 and 2024-03-01? I can run a small query if someone gives me the ES index name.
Sophia: index: invoices-prod-2024-02. Run and paste results here, please.
Leo: Ran and found 7 retries across 5 accounts, only BF-204 had a paid duplicate. I'll post CSV to ACCT-5428.
Raj: Good catch. Once the hotfix is in, let's schedule a batch cleanup for any unpaid "-RETRY" drafts older than 7 days.
Marta: Agreed. Closing loop once PR merged + cleanup run. :+1:
